en.whatIsIt: Apple scab is a severe fungal disease caused by Venturia inaequalis. It produces olive-green to dark velvety lesions on leaves and fruit, causing premature defoliation.
symptoms: Olive-green or brownish velvety spots on leaf surface
Curling, yellowing and premature leaf drop
en.recommendedAction: Apply protective fungicides (Captan, Mancozeb) at bud break. Rake and destroy fallen leaves to reduce overwintering ascospore inoculum.
en.immediateActionDesc: Apply captan or myclobutanil fungicide and rake up fallen leaves under canopy.

hi.whatIsIt: सेब का स्कैब (Apple Scab) एक फफूंद जनित रोग है जो पत्तियों और फलों पर काले-भूरे मखमली धब्बे बनाता है।
symptoms: पत्तियों पर जैतून-हरे से काले धब्बे
पत्तियों का मुड़ना और जल्दी गिरना
hi.recommendedAction: कली खिलते समय कैप्टन या मैंकोजेब कवकनाशी का छिड़काव करें और गिरी हुई पत्तियों को नष्ट करें।
hi.immediateActionDesc: तुरंत कैप्टन कवकनाशी का छिड़काव करें और बगीचे की सफाई करें।

en.whatIsIt: Black rot causes frogeye leaf spots, fruit rot, and twig cankers on apple trees, severely weakening the canopy.
symptoms: Small purple specks enlarging into 'frogeye' spots with tan centers
en.recommendedAction: Prune out dead wood, fire blight strikes, and cankers. Apply thiophanate-methyl or captan fungicide.
en.immediateActionDesc: Prune dead wood and mummified fruit, then apply protective fungicide.

en.whatIsIt: Cedar apple rust is a heteroecious rust fungus that requires both apple trees and eastern red cedar/juniper to complete its life cycle.
symptoms: Small black pycnia in centers of spots
en.recommendedAction: Apply sterol inhibitor fungicides (myclobutanil) early in spring. Remove nearby wild red cedar galls.
en.immediateActionDesc: Apply myclobutanil immediately and inspect nearby juniper trees.

en.whatIsIt: Apple foliage displays optimal chlorophyll saturation with no pathogenic lesion signatures.
en.recommendedAction: Maintain routine orchard sanitation, balanced fertilization, and moisture monitoring.
en.immediateActionDesc: No active intervention required; sustain preventive management.

en.whatIsIt: Blueberry foliage displays healthy photosynthetic pigmentation without necrotic symptoms.
en.recommendedAction: Keep soil pH acidic (4.5 - 5.5) and sustain organic mulch.
en.immediateActionDesc: Maintain soil acidity and drip irrigation schedule.

en.whatIsIt: Powdery mildew forms a circular white felt-like fungal coating on young cherry leaves and shoots.
symptoms: White talcum-like powdery patches on leaves
en.recommendedAction: Apply sulfur or potassium bicarbonate early. Prune to improve canopy air circulation.
en.immediateActionDesc: Spray micronized wettable sulfur or horticultural oil during cool periods.

en.whatIsIt: Cherry leaf canopy exhibits vigorous, uniform green structure.
en.recommendedAction: Continue regular pruning and preventive dormancy sprays.
en.immediateActionDesc: No active pathogen found.

en.whatIsIt: Gray leaf spot is a devastating foliar pathogen of corn, producing rectangular lesions delimited by leaf veins.
symptoms: Lesions restricted between parallel leaf veins
en.recommendedAction: Apply strobilurin or triazole fungicides before tasseling. Implement crop rotation with non-host crops.
en.immediateActionDesc: Apply pyraclostrobin or azoxystrobin before canopy closure.

en.whatIsIt: Common rust produces brick-red, powdery pustules on both upper and lower leaf surfaces of maize.
symptoms: Oval to elongate cinnamon-brown powdery pustules
en.recommendedAction: Plant resistant hybrids. In seed corn or sweet corn, apply triazole fungicides if rust appears before silking.
en.immediateActionDesc: Inspect lower leaves and apply triazole fungicide if >5% leaf area affected.

en.whatIsIt: Northern corn leaf blight causes large, cigar-shaped grayish-green lesions that destroy photosynthesizing tissue.
symptoms: Long elliptical or cigar-shaped grayish lesions (2-15 cm)
Dark fungal spores inside lesions during damp weather
en.recommendedAction: Rotate crops, till infected corn residue, and spray systemic fungicides when conditions favor spread.
en.immediateActionDesc: Apply strobilurin/triazole fungicide combination immediately.

en.whatIsIt: Corn plant shows robust leaf health with no blighting or pustules.
en.recommendedAction: Maintain balanced nitrogen nutrition and soil drainage.
en.immediateActionDesc: Maintain irrigation and scout regularly.

en.whatIsIt: Black rot affects all green vine parts, causing reddish-brown leaf spots with black border dots and shriveled black mummies.
symptoms: Tiny black fruiting bodies (pycnidia) in rings
Fruit turning into hard black mummies
en.recommendedAction: Apply myclobutanil or mancozeb at 10-14 day intervals from 1-inch shoot growth through post-bloom.
en.immediateActionDesc: Spray myclobutanil and prune out all mummified fruit clusters.

en.whatIsIt: Esca is a complex fungal vascular decline disease causing 'tiger-stripe' interveinal chlorosis and berry spotting.
symptoms: Tiger-stripe pattern of yellow/red bands between veins
en.recommendedAction: Prune during dry dormant periods. Seal pruning wounds with wound protectant. Replace severely stunted vines.
en.immediateActionDesc: Sanitize pruning tools and seal large wood wounds.

en.whatIsIt: Isariopsis leaf spot produces irregular brown necrotic patches bordered by yellow halos on grape leaves.
symptoms: Spots coalescing into large necrotic areas
en.recommendedAction: Apply copper or azoxystrobin fungicides. Prune excess vine canopy to encourage rapid airflow.
en.immediateActionDesc: Apply copper hydroxide spray and prune dense inner canopy.

en.whatIsIt: Grapevine canopy is in prime physiological health with strong photosynthetic efficiency.
en.recommendedAction: Maintain canopy wire training and preventive pest management.
en.immediateActionDesc: Canopy is healthy.

en.whatIsIt: Citrus greening (Huanglongbing) is an incurable bacterial disease vectored by the Asian citrus psyllid, leading to tree decline.
symptoms: Small, lopsided, bitter fruit with dark aborted seeds
en.recommendedAction: Control psyllid vectors with targeted insecticides. Remove confirmed infected trees to protect surrounding grove.
en.immediateActionDesc: Treat vector psyllids immediately and consult local agricultural quarantine.

en.whatIsIt: Bacterial spot causes water-soaked angular leaf lesions that drop out, giving foliage a 'shot-hole' appearance.
symptoms: Angular water-soaked leaf spots turning purple-brown
Cracked, pitted lesions on peach fruit
en.recommendedAction: Apply copper sprays at bud break and oxytetracycline during the growing season. Plant resistant peach varieties.
en.immediateActionDesc: Spray low-rate copper hydroxide or oxytetracycline during early vegetative flush.

en.whatIsIt: Peach tree foliage demonstrates clean, unspotted green lanceolate leaves.
en.recommendedAction: Maintain dormant copper sprays and balanced irrigation.
en.immediateActionDesc: Tree canopy is in excellent condition.

en.whatIsIt: Bacterial spot on bell peppers produces small, circular, dark brown lesions that expand and cause severe leaf dropping.
symptoms: Water-soaked circular lesions on lower leaf surfaces
Brown, necrotic centers with yellow chlorotic rings
en.recommendedAction: Apply fixed copper bactericide mixed with mancozeb. Avoid working in fields when foliage is wet.
en.immediateActionDesc: Spray copper hydroxide mixed with mancozeb to prevent bacterial spread.

en.whatIsIt: Bell pepper leaf is completely healthy with crisp green pigmentation.
en.recommendedAction: Maintain consistent drip moisture and balanced potassium-calcium feeding.
en.immediateActionDesc: No pathogen detected.

en.whatIsIt: Early blight is a fungal disease causing target-like concentric rings on potato leaves, usually starting on mature lower canopy.
symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric ring pattern
en.recommendedAction: Apply chlorothalonil, mancozeb, or copper fungicides at 7-10 day intervals. Ensure adequate soil nitrogen.
en.immediateActionDesc: Apply chlorothalonil spray and avoid overhead sprinkler watering.

en.whatIsIt: Late blight is the aggressive oomycete pathogen responsible for the Irish potato famine. It causes rapid rotting of vines and tubers.
symptoms: Large irregular water-soaked spots on leaves
White velvety sporulation on leaf underside in humid conditions
Rapid brown wilt and vine collapse
en.recommendedAction: Apply systemic fungicides (mefenoxam, cymoxanil, mandipropamid) immediately. Destroy severely blighted vines.
en.immediateActionDesc: Apply systemic late blight fungicide within 24 hours to halt field epidemic.

en.whatIsIt: Potato plant foliage displays prime health and strong vegetative development.
symptoms: No target rings or water-soaked lesions
en.recommendedAction: Continue preventive fungicide schedule during humid periods.
en.immediateActionDesc: Maintain proper hilling and scouting.

en.whatIsIt: Raspberry leaf exhibits healthy serrated structure and uniform pigmentation.
symptoms: Pinnate green leaves with pale undersides
en.recommendedAction: Prune out spent floricanes after fruiting and keep rows well-ventilated.
en.immediateActionDesc: Canes are healthy.

en.whatIsIt: Soybean trifoliate leaves are healthy with no fungal spotting or chlorosis.
en.recommendedAction: Scout weekly for pod pests and fungal rust during reproductive stages.
en.immediateActionDesc: Soybean canopy is robust.

en.whatIsIt: Powdery mildew creates distinctive white dusty powder spots on both sides of cucurbit leaves, reducing yield.
symptoms: White powdery talc-like spots on leaves and stems
Sunburn on fruit due to defoliation
en.recommendedAction: Apply potassium bicarbonate, neem oil, or synthetic fungicides (myclobutanil). Avoid crowded plant spacing.
en.immediateActionDesc: Spray potassium bicarbonate or azoxystrobin early morning.

en.whatIsIt: Leaf scorch produces numerous small purplish spots that enlarge and coalesce, giving the foliage a burned appearance.
symptoms: Irregular purple blotches without distinct white centers
Leaf edges curling upward and drying
en.recommendedAction: Remove infected leaves after harvest. Apply captan or dodine fungicide during spring leaf emergence.
en.immediateActionDesc: Prune dry scorched leaves and apply protective fungicide.

en.whatIsIt: Strawberry crown foliage shows vibrant, unblemished trifoliate leaves.
en.recommendedAction: Keep straw mulch fresh and avoid over-saturating crown.
en.immediateActionDesc: Crown is healthy.

en.whatIsIt: Bacterial spot causes small, dark, greasy water-soaked lesions that turn brown with yellow halos, causing heavy leaf drop.
symptoms: Black scab-like spots on green tomatoes
en.recommendedAction: Apply copper bactericide with mancozeb. Avoid overhead irrigation and sanitize pruning shears.
en.immediateActionDesc: Apply fixed copper hydroxide and eliminate overhead watering.

en.whatIsIt: Early blight is a fungal pathogen causing dark brown concentric target rings surrounded by yellow halos on tomato foliage.
symptoms: Dark concentric target rings on leaves
Progression from lower mature leaves upward
en.recommendedAction: Prune lower infected foliage. Apply copper hydroxide or chlorothalonil fungicide early in the morning.
en.immediateActionDesc: Prune bottom leaves showing dark rings and spray copper fungicide.

hi.whatIsIt: अगेती झुलसा (Early Blight) टमाटर का एक फफूंद जनित रोग है जो पत्तियों पर संकेंद्रित छल्ले बनाता है।
hi.recommendedAction: तुरंत कॉपर युक्त कवकनाशी का छिड़काव करें और निचली खराब पत्तियां काटें।

en.whatIsIt: Late blight is a fast-moving water mold that causes large pale green water-soaked spots turning rapidly dark brown and rotting vines.
symptoms: White fuzzy mold on leaf undersides in high humidity
Rapid stem rot and fruit browning
en.recommendedAction: Apply systemic fungicides (mancozeb, metalaxyl) immediately. Destroy collapsing infected plants.
en.immediateActionDesc: Apply systemic fungicide within 12 hours and prune rotting foliage.

en.whatIsIt: Leaf mold thrives in high relative humidity (>85%), causing pale greenish-yellow spots on upper leaf surfaces and olive-green velvet mold below.
symptoms: Pale yellow spots on upper leaf surface
Olive-green to grayish velvety mold on leaf underside
en.recommendedAction: Increase greenhouse ventilation and lower relative humidity below 80%. Apply copper or chlorothalonil fungicide.
en.immediateActionDesc: Prune inner canopy to improve ventilation and apply protective spray.

en.whatIsIt: Septoria leaf spot produces circular spots with dark brown margins and gray or tan centers containing tiny black dots.
symptoms: Small circular spots with dark borders and tan centers
Tiny black pycnidia specks inside spots
Severe bottom-up leaf yellowing and defoliation
en.recommendedAction: Apply organic mulch around plant base to prevent soil splash. Spray chlorothalonil or copper fungicide.
en.immediateActionDesc: Apply mulch to stop soil splashing and apply copper spray.

en.whatIsIt: Two-spotted spider mites pierce plant cells to feed on sap, causing yellow stippling and fine silken webbing on leaf undersides.
symptoms: Fine yellow or white stippling on leaf surface
Delicate silken webbing on leaf undersides and shoot tips
en.recommendedAction: Spray insecticidal soap, neem oil, or abamectin miticide. Release predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis).
en.immediateActionDesc: Spray neem oil or insecticidal soap thoroughly on leaf undersides.

en.whatIsIt: Target spot produces circular brown lesions with light brown centers and dark concentric rings across leaf blades and fruit.
symptoms: Small pinpoint brown spots expanding into target patterns
Lesions with light centers and dark concentric rings
Sunken crater-like spots on green tomatoes
en.recommendedAction: Apply azoxystrobin, chlorothalonil, or copper fungicides. Ensure adequate plant spacing to facilitate rapid foliage drying.
en.immediateActionDesc: Apply azoxystrobin and increase canopy spacing.

en.whatIsIt: TYLCV is a devastating geminivirus transmitted by whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci), causing stunted growth, cupped leaves, and complete yield failure.
symptoms: Severe upward curling and cupping of leaflets
Extreme stunting of plants and bushy upright habit
en.recommendedAction: Control whitefly vectors using yellow sticky traps and systemic insecticides. Rogue out infected plants immediately.
en.immediateActionDesc: Rogue out infected plants immediately and treat whiteflies with imidacloprid or insecticidal soap.

en.whatIsIt: ToMV is a highly stable tobamovirus spread easily by mechanical contact, pruning tools, and hands, causing mottled leaves and distortion.
symptoms: Mottled light and dark green mosaic patterns on leaves
Fern-like leaf distortion and stringy foliage
Internal brown browning in tomato fruit
en.recommendedAction: Wash hands with soap and disinfect pruning shears with 20% non-fat dry milk or trisodium phosphate. Remove infected plants.
en.immediateActionDesc: Remove infected plant, do not compost, and sanitize all tools thoroughly.

en.whatIsIt: Tomato plant foliage is in pristine health with vibrant dark green chlorophyll and no pathogenic lesions.
symptoms: No chlorotic halos, curling, or necrotic spots
Strong vascular stems and healthy trichomes
en.recommendedAction: Maintain standard drip irrigation, calcium nutrition to prevent blossom end rot, and regular scouting.
en.immediateActionDesc: Plant is fully healthy; sustain balanced irrigation and nutrition.
